source: cv_06_roi_align torch model.py 实测（model.py 即被测实现；warmup=3, 每次 msprof --ai-core task_time 取两次 erf 哨兵间 kernel 时延之和）; measured impl = /home/zzy-work/cv_perf_level3/adapters/ref_17_roi_align.py. Caliber: warmup=25, repeats=10, per-case msprof capture, trailing-10 mean; gap-fenced iteration segmentation (instrumented sync+sleep separator, floor 9 ms); convergence gate = |drift| <= 5% on mean(2nd half of last 10)/mean(1st half), judged separately for e2e and core. MFU DENOMINATOR CHANGED (pre-delivery, 2026-09-13): all ten CV operators are now divided by the vector peak 48 x 0.2304 = 11.0592 TFLOPS (48 measured -- the framework's own Transpose kernels launch at Block Dim = 48; cross-checked against the archived profile's 'AI Core Freq 1800 MHz'), instead of the 353.8944 fp16 Cube peak used by the previously shipped 12-21 perf.json. MFU here is therefore ~32x the shipped file's. This is a caliber unification, NOT a statement that the engines are uniform -- measured per case they are not: 12/15/16/19 are pure AI_VECTOR_CORE, 13 adds MIX_AIV, 14 runs MIX_AIC on 34 of 47 cases and really occupies the Cube (cube_utilization 85-95%), and 17/18/20/21 carry AI_CPU cases that never reach an AI Core. The vector peak is exact only for the pure-AIV operators; for 14 the Cube peak is arguably closer, and for AI_CPU cases neither applies. MFU is a tie-breaker in this pipeline -- quote it with achieved_bw_gbs, never alone. Per-operator engine mix: OPT_HINTS.md. FORMAT NOTICE (added 2026-09-13): this file does NOT carry an accuracy verdict. The previously shipped 12-21 perf.json had `accuracy_passed_cases` (top level) and a per-case `accuracy`; the schema used here records `cases_valid` (a usable msprof capture was obtained) and `cases_converged` (the |drift| <= 5% gate passed) instead -- NEITHER is an accuracy statement, and neither should be read as one. Accuracy evidence exists by route and its strength is NOT uniform: for the bridge routes (12/13/14/15/16/20) `wrapper.py --check` compares the adapter against the repo Model and is a genuine comparison rather than a self-comparison; the measuring lanes REPORT max_abs_diff 0.000e+00 on the cases they sampled (REPORTED, NOT RE-VERIFIED IN THIS PASS, and this pass did not sample 12 or 16); for the pure-delegate torch routes (17/18/19/21) the same check compares the Model against itself and is TAUTOLOGICAL -- it confirms wiring and shapes only, not accuracy. Per-case `impl_latency_us` was renamed `latency_us`; same quantity, same caliber, no alias is provided, so a consumer keying on the old name must be updated. NOTE (engine caliber, added 2026-09-13 by the consolidation pass): core_us here is NOT pure device time. Measured per case (the `engines` field): all 50/50 cases carry AI_CPU alongside AI_VECTOR_CORE -- the same aclnn entry point runs partly on the host CPU. This file therefore cannot be compared with the pure-AI_VECTOR_CORE operators (12/15/16/19) as if the numbers meant the same thing; it is comparable with 18/20/21, which are contaminated the same way. AI_CPU CONTAMINATION (added 2026-09-13 by the consolidation pass). The machine-readable form of this is the per-case `engines` / `has_aicpu` fields, which ARE fields of this file -- key any decision on those, not on the percentage below. The percentage is MEASURED BY HAND and is NOT a field: the owning lane reports 94-98% of core_us on 4 cases, with the AI_CPU op being `Index`. This pass recomputed case 0 from the kept capture `keep17/case_0/` and got 94.6% over all captured iterations versus 86.3% over the trailing 10, which is the definition-dependence range in action. DEFINITION-DEPENDENT, and this pass could not reconcile the lanes' conventions: recomputing from the same kept captures moves the figure materially, because BOTH the row window AND whether the glue set (Transpose/TransData/Cast/MemSet/ZerosLike/ViewCopy) is stripped change the denominator. Quote it with its convention or not at all. CONSEQUENCE regardless of the exact number: core_us for the flagged cases is partly HOST CPU time, so those cases must NOT enter an AI-Core-utilization comparison, and an optimization aimed at AI Core work cannot reach that part of the time.
caliber: warmup=25, repeats=10, per-case msprof capture, trailing-10 mean; gap-fenced iteration segmentation (instrumented sync+sleep separator, floor 9 ms); convergence gate = |drift| <= 5% on mean(2nd half of last 10)/mean(1st half), judged separately for e2e and core

window_mix.note: extended_cases were re-measured ONLY after failing the convergence gate at the modal window; no case that already passed was re-rolled. paired_ab_bound_pct is the largest per-case move seen in a same-case paired A/B between the modal and the extended window (null = not established for this operator, which is NOT the same as zero).
